title: My Evil Twin
author: Carl Muckenhoupt
description:
After last night's all-nighter (I had an important report to do for work), I intended to sleep all through the day. But I can't afford to do that. Somewhere out there, my evil twin is plying his schemes, and I'm the only one who can stop him.

(An adaption of the They Might Be Giants song of the same name.)
